# Staking events lost to the tx_search outage on rpc-coreum.ecostake.com.
# Recovered by diffing /api/staking-feed against coreum-rpc.publicnode.com,
# then confirmed against the chain by a --dry-run of this file.
#
# Window : heights 84809131-85390039 (2026-08-29T17:06Z to 2026-09-03T18:05Z)
# Missing: 61 events, 70,069,210 TX. 60 delegate, 1 undelegate.
#
# The dry run is what set the final count. The diff had 69 candidates because
# it summed every staking event in a transaction; the collector filters per
# event. Eight of them were batch restakes whose individual delegations all
# sit under the 5000 TX threshold (the largest single leg was 4,468 TX), so
# the collector would never have stored them and they are not losses. They
# are removed here rather than left to insert nothing.
#
# Loss rate climbs through the window, 6% on Aug 29 to 44% on Sep 3, so the
# node degraded rather than failing at a point in time, and events before
# this window are affected too. The feed holds 90 days but the chain-side
# search is what broke, so anything past the public nodes' index retention
# cannot be recovered this way.
#
# Replay with:
#   node vm-service/backfill-staking-tx.mjs --file=vm-service/backfills/2026-09-03-rpc-outage.txt --dry-run
#   node vm-service/backfill-staking-tx.mjs --file=vm-service/backfills/2026-09-03-rpc-outage.txt
